images.title: Road to school, park times
images.purpose: Set up the two word problems: how far Jaya walks after the auto ride, and who is faster round the park, where units must match before taking away or comparing.
images.composition: One long straight road across the upper half with wide space around it, and one short line of park times centred in the lower half.
images.exact_structure: Top: one straight flat road drawn as a horizontal band from a small plain house on the left to a small plain school building on the right. The road is split by one grey #6B7280 tick into two segments, drawn as a sketch and not to scale, the left one about two thirds of the road: the left segment, the auto ride, is teal #0072B2; the right segment, the walk, is amber #E69F00. No other ticks. Bottom, centred: one plain text line with the two park times and one question line under it. No people, no vehicles. Exactly 1 road, 2 segments, 2 buildings.
labels: who is faster, by how much?
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any answer to either question shown, such as a walking distance, a faster runner or a time difference
images.takeaway: Make the units the same before you take away or compare.
images.description: A road from home to school of 7/10 km, with the auto part of 1/2 km in teal and the walking part marked ? km in amber; below, Jeevika's 10/3 minutes and Namit's 13/4 minutes with the question who is faster. No answers are shown.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to say which units 7/10 and 1/2 are in, and what unit both could be written in before taking away.

image_decisions.why: A road split into the ride and the walk turns the word problem into a take away, without giving the answer.
